d: Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri briefed the media in Manila following the conclusion of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's participation in the 23rd India-ASEAN Summit, the 21st East Asia Summit, and the 7th Quad Leaders' Summit. Highlighting the Prime Minister's message amidst global geopolitical flux, Misri noted that "what the world really needs today is peace, stability, and predictability." He described the 7th Quad Summit as substantive, forward-looking, and practical, reaffirming all four partner nations' commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific and ASEAN centrality.
